message.content:
It sounds like you want to start Docker on a Windows machine. There are two common interpretations of “start Docker”: | What you might mean | How to do it | |---------------------|--------------| | **Start the Docker daemon (so you can run containers)** | In a PowerShell prompt run:
`Start-Service com.docker.service`
or in a CMD prompt:
`net start com.docker.service` | | **Start a specific container** | You need the container’s name or ID. Then run:
`docker start ` | If you’re trying to start the Docker *service* (the background engine), the first set of commands will do it. If you’re trying to start a container, replace `` with the actual name or ID of the container you want to bring up. Let me know which one you’re after, or if you have a specific container name you’d like to start!
